title: LIT on MFFU Rapid 50K (consistency-aware eval + funded with the Tier-1 calendar)
question: Can stacked MFFU Rapid / Rapid EOD accounts run LIT next to the Builder 50K, and what do they pay?

notes: tools/lit_mffu_rapid_stack.py; stored trades = back-to-back real history, funded trades only (news rule applied). The run library's eval columns are not this plan's: see the verdict and research/lit/mffu_rapid_stack.json.
